standard.name: Standard Conversational Marathi (प्रमाण संवाद)
standard.description: Clean, universally understood polite register across Maharashtra. Balanced loanwords, courteous formal honorifics.

pune_mumbai.name: Pune & Mumbai Urban Modern (पुणे-मुंबई शहरी लबक)
pune_mumbai.description: Fast-paced urban cadence, higher frequency of English tech and lifestyle loanwords (appointment, schedule, client).

solapur_kolhapur_style.name: Western Maharashtra / Solapur-Kolhapur Register (पश्चिम महाराष्ट्र लबक)
solapur_kolhapur_style.description: Lively rhythmic cadence, warm local colloquialisms (बगा, सांगा की, व्हय).
